role_in_the_equations: entering water temperature: TRan = T_a - T_b, the correlation's range
leaving water temperature: the model output being validated, and the other end of TRan
TApp = TOut - TWetBul; the correlation is a polynomial in (TWetBul, TRan, liquid-to-gas ratio)
FRWat = m_flow / (FRWat0 * m_flow_nominal), the liquid side of the liquid-to-gas ratio
FRAir = y, the gas side of the liquid-to-gas ratio, and the switch between forced and free convection
cell count: converts plant flow to per-cell flow before FRWat
fan power is reported, never used to rank candidates (section 2.6)
entering water temperature: UA-corrected epsilon-NTU boundary
leaving water temperature: model output being validated
air-side inlet enthalpy is taken at the wet bulb
water-side capacity rate m*cp in the NTU correction
air-side capacity rate through the fan-speed ratio
the calibration target: P = P_nominal * capFT * EIRFT * EIRFPLR
leaving evaporator temperature: the first argument of capFT and EIRFT
entering condenser temperature: the second argument of capFT and EIRFT for ElectricEIR
evaporator mass flow: sets the load Q = m*cp*dT that drives PLR
entering evaporator temperature: the other end of that dT
condenser mass flow: boundary condition on the condenser volume
LEAVING condenser temperature replaces the entering one in EIRFT and EIRFPLR -- the reformulation is exactly this substitution
the calibration target: P = P_nominal * (c0 + c1*phi + c2*y + c3*y^3 + c4*phi*y)
y = speed / speed_nominal, the only argument of the affinity and speed-poly forms
phi = m_flow / m_flow_nominal, used only by the speed-flow form and only where attribution covers at least half the running record
the pump curve is shaped by a measured nominal flow; without one the mover cannot be instantiated
side-1 inlet temperature in Q = eps * Cmin * (T_a1 - T_a2)
side-2 inlet temperature, the other end of that difference
side-1 capacity rate C1 = m1*cp; Cmin needs both
side-2 capacity rate C2 = m2*cp; Cmin needs both
side-2 outlet: the uncontrolled output validated against
side-1 outlet closes the duty used to identify UA in eps = f(NTU, Cr)
